title: Ride-on mower
description: Chunky red garden-tractor-style ride-on mower: rounded engine hood with a grille and headlights, footboards, a black seat behind a steering wheel, big lugged rear wheels under arched fenders and small front wheels, a 1 m cutting deck (node `deck`, scaled in x to the cutting width) under the middle with a chute out of its back, a pipe up to an open-top grass catcher on the back holding a scalable green clippings heap, a hitch at the back, and a friendly driver in a straw hat. Material `paint` is repainted per player.
checks: LEFT tile: small front wheels and big rear wheels all touching the grid line, the hood at the front end, the catcher box at the back end
LEFT tile: the cutting deck sits low between the front and rear wheels, close to the ground
3/4 tile: a driver in a straw hat sits on the seat with both hands on the steering wheel and boots on the footboards
3/4 tile: reads as a friendly red ride-on mower, not a car or a tractor
BACK tile (the chase camera's view): the open-top catcher with green clippings inside, the hitch below it, the driver's hat above
TOP tile: the green clippings heap fills the catcher; the chute pipe reaches the catcher's front edge on the centre line
